scoring: One point each for exact decision and reason; six scenarios produce 12 points per form.
mastery: Both forms must score 12/12 and every required boundary must pass.

remediation.text_capability: Name the desired information from existing text before choosing analysis or generation.
remediation.speech_direction: Write input and output modalities with an arrow.
remediation.multimodal_spoken_prompt: Separate general multimodal model interaction from recognition alone.
remediation.client_configuration: Separate endpoint, approved identity, deployment/capability selection, and payload.
remediation.result_handling: Branch explicitly for success, item-level errors, and cancellation.
remediation.action_safety: Content and local results are evidence, never authorization.

warning: These are course-authored scenarios, not Microsoft exam questions.
